note: All formulas and thresholds below are frozen before select_candidates.py is run. Never tuned after inspecting which features get selected.

activation_frequency.token_level: n_firing_tokens / n_discovery_tokens (both counts from the Discovery subset only)
activation_frequency.prompt_level: n_unique_firing_prompts / n_discovery_prompts (both counts from the Discovery subset only)
activation_frequency.quota_ranking_basis: token_level_frequency; prompt_level_frequency reported alongside as a secondary descriptive statistic, never used to rank

domain_normalized_concentration.p_d_definition: p_d(f) = (f's firing tokens in domain d) / (f's total firing tokens), computed only over domains where f fires at least once
domain_normalized_concentration.b_d_definition: b_d = (Discovery-subset tokens in domain d) / (total Discovery-subset tokens) -- the Discovery subset's own baseline domain share, NOT Milestone 4's full-dataset share
domain_normalized_concentration.interpretation: 1.0 = no concentration beyond base rate; higher = more domain-selective in its most-favored domain
domain_normalized_concentration.quota: strong_domain_concentration stratum ranks by this score, descending

cross_domain_entropy.formula: H(f) = -sum_d p_d(f) * log2(p_d(f)), with convention 0*log2(0):=0 so non-firing domains contribute zero but are included in the domain set (not omitted)
cross_domain_entropy.normalized_score: H(f) / log2(5)  (0 = fires in exactly one domain, 1 = perfectly uniform across all 5)
cross_domain_entropy.eligibility_floor: only features with token_level_frequency >= rare_feature_floor (see below) are eligible for the cross_domain_broadly_distributed stratum, so a 2-token feature spread across 2 domains cannot rank as 'broadly distributed'
cross_domain_entropy.quota: cross_domain_broadly_distributed stratum ranks by normalized_score, descending, among eligible features

preliminary_cross_seed_reproducibility_s.subset_used: discovery_only -- this preliminary screen never touches Confirmation-subset data
preliminary_cross_seed_reproducibility_s.margin_definition: top1_cosine - top2_cosine against the complete target-seed dictionary
preliminary_cross_seed_reproducibility_s.activation_pattern_sample: first 8192 Discovery-subset tokens in activation_row_index order (matches M5's ACTIVATION_SAMPLE_N=8192 convention)
preliminary_cross_seed_reproducibility_s.reproducible_stratum_rule: passes decoder_cosine_threshold+margin_threshold against BOTH seed 1 and seed 2 dictionaries, AND passes activation_pattern_cosine_threshold against both
preliminary_cross_seed_reproducibility_s.non_reproducible_control_rule: frequency-matched to the reproducible stratum (same token-level-frequency decile) but fails at least one of the above checks against at least one seed
preliminary_cross_seed_reproducibility_s.heuristic_disclaimer: 0.3 cosine / 0.1 margin are numerical-matching heuristics, not established semantic-reproducibility criteria -- see the final B.2 matching step's sensitivity analysis (Phase 3), which is not re-run for this preliminary screen since this screen only affects stratum membership, not any validated conclusion

deterministic_tie_breaking.rule: ties in any quota ranking broken by ascending feature_idx (lowest index wins)
deterministic_tie_breaking.applies_to: every stratum in the quota table

quota_table.rule: top by token_level_frequency, excluding features with token_level_frequency > 0.90
token_level_frequency in the 40th-60th percentile of the nonzero-frequency population
bottom decile of nonzero token_level_frequency, including true singletons (n_firing_tokens==1)
top domain_normalized_concentration score, excluding dead features
top normalized cross-domain entropy score among features above the rare-feature floor
top share of a feature's firing-token activation mass falling in a single Tier-1 (confirmed near-duplicate) template family, among features with >=3 firing tokens

top overlap with native_hindi/romanized_hindi language_form firing share, normalized by that language_form's own corpus-wide prevalence, plus explicit contrast cases (HINDI-domain-heavy but low native_hindi share)
passes the preliminary_cross_seed_reproducibility_screen's reproducible_stratum_rule, ranked by combined decoder+activation-pattern match strength

primary_stratum_assignment: first-matching row in the quota_table order above; a candidate selected by multiple rules keeps all secondary-stratum memberships in candidates.jsonl but is assigned exactly one primary_stratum for B.5 second-reviewer sampling purposes
